scope: Static metadata, DEX identifiers and string constants; no APK execution or backend requests. Bundled code is not proof a feature is enabled.

res/layout/activity_settings_app.xml: Automatically print Kitchen Order Tickets (KOT) when orders are placed.
Enable Station-wise KOT
Print specific items on separate KOT printers based on their assigned station.
Show a 'Print Bill' button to let you print and save bills separately.
Include 'Powered by Arow' text at the bottom of printed bills.
Enable management for Zomato and Swiggy orders directly in the app.
Custom Day Start Time
For restaurants open past midnight. Example: setting to 03:00 means the day rolls over at 3 AM instead of 12 AM.
Select Time: 00:00
Allow customers to pay later using store credit (Khata).
Exit to main screen on KOT print or send to KDS to speed up order punching.
Allow staff to add special cooking instructions to items.
Enable WhatsApp Bill Sharing
Send digital bills to customers directly via WhatsApp.
Round Off Taxes
Automatically round off calculated tax amounts.
Hide Server Name
Hide the server name from the printed bill PDF.
Offline Billing Mode (Owner Only)
Enable local offline billing on owner phone. Restricts staff devices to prevent offline invoice conflicts.
Hide Big Total
Hide the large total amount printed at the bottom of the bill.
Disable Menu Beep
Turn off the beep sound when punching items in the menu.
Soundbox
Speaks out the total bill amount when the order is completed.
res/layout/activity_settings_kds.xml: Automatically send KOTs to kitchen display.
Play sound when a new KOT is received.
Open arowapp.com/kds on your Smart TV, Tablet, or Phone.
Optimized for Smart TVs, Tablets, and Smartphones.
A QR code will appear on the display.
Click the button below and scan the QR code.
